title: Design of wind power plants in Denmark
lineage: Inspected the cited passages; the retained file is a paraphrased research note.

passages.locator: UN proceedings W/17, summary and Gedser mill
passages.note: Juul reports a 200 kW plant completed in 1957, put into service in June 1958, with Danish government grants for the pilot and three measuring stations; the plant cost 272,000 Danish crowns excluding other specified costs.
